tank_description: A single-shot electromagnetic railgun that charges before it fires and deals impressively high damage, with shells that can carry on into a second target. Hypercharge spends Energy to boost penetration and cut reload time, and Energy APS raises a 360-degree force field that intercepts incoming shells, though you can't fire through it. Base armor is thin, but the M1R reverses as fast as it drives forward.
